# Descriptions
@@ 1
Caster enchants one suitable holy item and turns it into his personal Holy
Symbol. This Holy Symbol is aligned to the caster's faith. Any being who is an
'enemy' of the caster's faith or a creature 'of darkness' that picks up the
symbol must make an RR or take an 'A' Holy Spell critical.
@@ 2
Caster may store one spell on his Holy Symbol. The spell to be stored must be
cast within one minute after the Symbol Store is cast. The stored spell may
then be later cast as an instantaneous spell. No other spell may be cast while
a spell is stored.
@@ 3
Any spell prepared while this spell is active will receive a special bonus of
+5 on any Spell Casting Static Maneuver.
@@ 4
While holding the Holy Symbol, the caster gains +10 to DB and RRs for the
duration.
@@ 5
Caster's Holy Symbol erupts in holy light that flares out to one foe. Target
must resist or suffer an 'A' Holy Spell critical. If the creature is an
'enemy' or 'of darkness' the critical is a ''B', and the RR is made with a
special modification of -20.
@@ 7
As Minor Symbol except it makes the Holy Symbol a +2 spell adder.
@@ 8
While holding the Holy Symbol, the caster gains +15 to DB and RRs for the
duration.
@@ 9
As Symbol Blast I, except that the critical is a 'B' for normal targets, and a
'C' if an 'enemy' or 'of darkness'.
@@ 10
As Symbol Store, except other spells may be cast while a spell is stored.
@@ 11
As Symbol Prayer, except the bonus is +10.
@@ 13
As Symbol Blast I, except that the critical is a 'C' for normal targets, and a
'D' if an 'enemy' or 'of darkness'.
@@ 14
While holding the Holy Symbol the caster gains +20 to DB and RRs for the
duration.
@@ 15
Caster's Holy Symbol is personalized to himself. Others that pick up the Holy
Symbol must or take a 'C' Holy Spell critical Anyone who is an 'enemy' of the
caster's faith who picks up the Holy Symbol must make an RR or take an 'E'
Holy Spell critical.
@@ 16
As Minor Symbol except it also makes the Holy Symbol a x2 power point
multiplier.
@@ 18
As Symbol Blast I, except that the critical is a 'D' for normal targets, and
an 'E' if an 'enemy' or 'of darkness'.
@@ 20
As Symbol Prayer I, except the bonus is +25.
@@ 25
While holding the Holy Symbol the caster gains +25 to DB and RRs for the
duration.
@@ 30
Caster becomes a recipient of his deity's spells. Once per round the caster's
deity may choose to channel one spell or effect through the caster. At least
one spell or effect is granted with this spell and if the caster moves before
this spell expires, this spell is canceled.
@@ 50
Caster sacrifices his Holy Symbol to his deity for a one time bonus of +50 to
a Divine Intervention Static Maneuver. If the caster receives any aid, he may
never have another Holy Symbol again.
